goal: Require the OP_RETURN data argument in createrawtransaction to be a hex string
Prevents accidental numeric values whose digits form valid hex from being accepted
agreement: Strong support for enforcing strict string validation on OP_RETURN data
Support noted the fix also avoids an unnecessary string copy (maflcko)
Suggested improving general hex parser error reporting in a follow-up (stickies-v)
